findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done — `close._block` chooses the dismissal text before the scored below-bar text. A below-bar finding dismissed by the owner, or automatically dismissed when repeated, is therefore shown in the updated pull request without Gain, Work or Harm. A scored Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 1 finding in a light review also passes the P0-only gate but falls through to scoreless advisory text, because `score.bar` calls it `fix now`. Both cases break item 2’s requirement to list every below-bar finding with its scores.
findings.title: Not done: 2 — below-bar findings can lose their scores in the pull request

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done — A repeated below-bar or owner-accepted finding is automatically dismissed in the next review. `_settled` then overwrites its `known:` or `accepted by the owner:` reason with `dismissed because ...`. `_accepted` includes only the former reason prefixes, so the third and later review prompts omit the finding from Known and accepted, despite item 3 requiring it to reach every later review.
findings.title: Not done: 3 — settled findings disappear from later accepted context

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done — The area identifier contains only the function name and file. Common methods such as `__init__` in different classes of one Python file therefore share an area. Findings in those separate methods can trigger a false third-finding stop; resolving it then settles all of them and can dismiss later at-bar Harm 1 or 2 findings in an unrelated class.
findings.title: Not done: 4 — same-named methods collapse into one area

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done — Before launching review four, this gate passes only `state['known']` to `score.loop_stops`. An item with three scored blocked rounds saved before the `known` field was introduced has an empty list here. A repeated at-bar Harm 1 or 2 finding is consequently not recognized, so Forge launches a fourth review instead of stopping after three. The later backfill of saved rounds happens only after that review.
